messages:
Maya K (IC): hi team — booked and paid for the "AI Summit Berlin" registration on my personal card because the company card was declined at checkout. I have the receipt/email confirmation from the organizer (VAT included). do I need pre-approval retroactively? and can Finance reclaim VAT since it was on my personal card?

expense-bot: Reminder: Company policy requires pre-approval for conference registration costs > $500. Please attach proof of pre-approval or request a retrospective approval.

Ava R (People Ops): thanks for flagging. short answer: we can reimburse and handle VAT reclaim in many cases, but we need a few things from you to process cleanly. please submit an expense and: (1) attach the organizer invoice (must be an itemized VAT invoice if you want VAT recovery), (2) include the payment confirmation or card statement showing the charge, (3) add a brief note explaining why the company card couldn't be used (e.g., card declined), and (4) request retrospective manager approval in the expense form.

Maya K (IC): I only have the order confirmation email and a pdf receipt that lists VAT but not the vendor tax id. the confirmation says "invoice to follow" but it's delayed. should I wait?

Nikhil P (Finance): if the invoice is missing the vendor tax id we can't file for VAT reclaim yet. two options: a) submit now for gross reimbursement (we'll reimburse you USD equivalent and tag as non-reclaimable VAT) and then submit the VAT invoice later for reclaim adjustments, or b) wait until the proper invoice arrives and submit once VAT invoice is available. pick whichever is faster for you.

Zoe L (Manager): retrospective approval from me is fine. Maya — please ping me in the expense form and put the conference reason + benefit in 1 sentence so I can sign off.

Ava R (People Ops): extra notes on process: - For reimbursements on personal cards, use expense type "Registration - Personal Card" and set currency to EUR. - For conversions, use the transaction date exchange rate (we accept xe.com or Google; paste link or screenshot). - If the vendor provides a VAT invoice later, upload it to the same expense and tag @Nikhil so Finance can process VAT reclaim. - Our policy allows retrospective approvals but repeated pattern of avoiding company card will trigger a review by Procurement.

Maya K (IC): great, i'll submit now as gross reimbursement and upload the confirmation. i'll DM Zoe for the approval text. estimated amount €720 incl VAT.

Nikhil P (Finance): quick FYI on accounting: if you submit now as gross, we'll code it to the events GL and mark VAT as unrecoverable until we receive a qualifying invoice. if the organizer later provides a VAT invoice with vendor tax id and it meets local reclaim rules, we'll process a recovery journal and reimburse any tax difference. keep originals — we may need them for auditors.

Maya K (IC): uploaded: confirmation pdf + screenshot of my card charge. put the note "company card was declined; requesting retro approval from Zoe".

Zoe L (Manager): approved. Maya: "Approved - benefit: product visibility / lead gen at AI Summit Berlin". signing off.

expense-bot: Expense 1892468012 submitted: awaiting manager approval.

expense-bot: Manager approval recorded for Expense 1892468012. Forwarding to Finance for reimbursement processing.

Nikhil P (Finance): Received. Maya — we'll reimburse the USD equivalent on the next payroll cycle as an expense reimbursement (not taxable). If you later upload a VAT invoice we will file for reclaim; any successful VAT recovery will be credited back to the company and won't change your reimbursement amount.

Maya K (IC): thanks all! saved the original invoice email and will follow up if the VAT invoice arrives.
